notes: No DMOJ AC submission is on file: orig.cpp is the IOI task archive's model solution (2025/day2/migrations/solutions/model_solution/zein_Z4_M8.cpp, Z = 4, M = 8) with the sample grader as its main, the two phases in separate processes; it scores in full on all 132 official tests (the adaptive type-3 ones replayed from the archive's manager.cpp) under checker.py. dream.tests/grader.cpp is that sample grader; the package has no stdin port, so the gates run the @grader(two_phase) dream through it, each phase in its own process, as the judge does. The dream's `@grader(two_phase) mod` became two top-level @grader fns: only those are built for the grader. Its fresh diameter at each phase could pick a tied pair outside the candidate lists; it now tracks the ends on a JumpTree.
